content: MCP tool registration pattern: each tool module has a register(mcp, ...) function that uses @mcp.tool() decorator to register tools. Core dependencies (clob_client, poly_client, safety_config) are injected via register() params, not imported globally. Read-only tools need no injected deps.

title: Pre-trade safety validation
rationale: All order placements run through safety.py before hitting the API. Checks: order size, spread, liquidity, exposure, and confirmation threshold. This prevents accidental large orders and protects against adverse market conditions. Confirmation tokens expire on consumption.
